export.heading: Export
export.description: Choose what goes into the JSON file.
export.passphraseLabel: Passphrase — leave blank to export without any secrets
export.secretsIncludedNote: SSH passwords and key passphrases will be included, encrypted with this passphrase. There is no way to recover them if you forget it.
export.secretsExcludedNote: SSH passwords and key passphrases stay in the Windows Credential Manager and are not written to the file.

import.heading: Import
import.hint: Nothing is changed until you confirm on the next screen.
import.summary: Imported: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{rules}} router rules, {{secrets}} secrets, {{hosts}} known hosts.
import.conflictWarning: {{count}} imported tunnel(s) share a name with one you already have, but are a different tunnel.
import.conflictReplace: Replace mine. Unticked, they come in as separate copies named "… (imported)".
import.routerCheckbox: Router config + rules — <replaces>replaces</replaces> your {{current}} rule(s) with {{incoming}}
import.knownHostsCheckbox: Known hosts ({{count}}) — merged; yours always win
import.noSecretsNote: This file contains no secrets — you will need to re-enter passwords and key passphrases for imported tunnels.
